name: Breadwinner World
desc:
A socioeconomic MMO about stacking bread.

The Demiurge has wrought:

🌾 The endless, satisfying toil of stacking bread 🍞
💵 A player-run economy of investment, trade, and business 📈
🌍 A walkable, single-server world of persistent villages 🌐
🪑 Homes you decorate that remain when you log off 🏠
